name: Crossword Clue Tutor
message: I maintain Crossword Clue Tutor, a free, independently written dictionary of crossword answer meanings and clue patterns. The current dictionary contains 100 reviewed entries. Each entry includes an original definition, pronunciation, part of speech, common clue patterns, crossword-specific usage notes, and DefinedTerm structured data. No account or payment is required, and the definition pages contain no advertising. Dictionary: https://crosswordcluetutor.com/crosswordese/ One-link-per-headword index: https://crosswordcluetutor.com/assets/onelook-dictionary.txt Editorial policy: https://crosswordcluetutor.com/editorial-policy/ The headword index follows OneLook's optional webmaster format and is generated from the same reviewed source data as the public dictionary. Would Crossword Clue Tutor be suitable for inclusion in OneLook's index? I am happy to adjust the format if needed. Full disclosure: I maintain the submitted site.
